name: mouse-wave-text
title: Mouse Wave Text
description: A giant word cut into thin vertical strips, each bobbing up and down with a moving delay so the letters ripple in a wave. Moving the cursor steers the wave and pressing the mouse squashes the whole word.
use: A hero word should feel alive and respond to the pointer without shipping a video.
avoid: It listens on the whole window, so the wave shifts even when the pointer is far from the words.
a11y: Each strip keeps the full text and none are hidden from assistive tech, so the word may be read hundreds of times. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The word Wavelength set in very heavy white capitals across a black stage, with a soft grey duplicate sitting just behind and below it. The tops of the letters stand at uneven heights, giving a rippled silhouette.
behaves: A wave runs across the word, lifting and dropping each narrow slice in turn while the cursor's horizontal position shifts its phase. Holding the mouse presses the word down as the grey shadow blurs and shrinks, and releasing springs it back.
customise: Pass any short string as children; colours for the text, shadow and wrapper come from three class props, while the wave timing is fixed in constants.
weight: heavy: Roughly one strip per two pixels, so hundreds of motion values react to the cursor.
